glosses: To lose (weight) by doing physical work; to burn off the calories gained from eating something.

examples.text: We need to get moving to work off these donuts.

glosses: To end (a debt) by doing labor for the person owed money.

examples.text: After thirteen years, I've worked off my student debt.

glosses: To produce (printed matter etc.) by some process of work.

examples.text: Pale Colour. When the sheets are worked off with too little ink.
